name: report

select.description: Which read to run. A field marked [select: ...] applies only to the selects named.

rootId.description: Only this depth-0 root (UUID or 8-32 hex prefix). Default: all you may see. [select: usage, gates, contention, waste]

since.description: Window start, inclusive: ISO 8601 with Z or offset. Default and cap: describe.

until.description: Window end, exclusive: ISO 8601 with Z or offset.

groupBy.description: Row grouping; subset and default per select. [select: usage, gates, contention]

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 200 (default 50). [select: usage, gates, contention]

cursor.description: page.next of the last page. [select: usage, gates, contention]

anchorId.description: Roll up this subtree (UUID or 8-32 hex prefix). [select: rollup]

runId.description: Roll up this run (UUID or 8-32 hex prefix). [select: rollup]

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Aggregate reports. select: usage (call metrics per group), gates (rejected transitions), contention (claims, leases), waste (ratios), rollup (subtree or run summary). Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
